function.name: search_text
function.description: Search the text extracted from the pages. Returns page identifiers and scores.

function.name: search_pages
function.description: Search the page images by visual and textual content. Returns page identifiers and scores.

function.name: view_page
function.description: Show the image of a page. crop is [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the page width and height.

function.name: calculate
function.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression with + - * / and **.

function.name: answer
function.description: Give the final answer and the page identifiers it is based on.
